facts.text: Bethel's community commitments include abstaining from drugs, tobacco, and other controlled substances, and honoring sexuality through marriage between one man and one woman.

sources.title: Key Commitments | Bethel University
sources.quote: Honoring sexuality through fidelity in marriage (between one man and one woman) and abstinence in singleness; cohabitation is not permitted. Abstaining from drugs, tobacco, and other controlled substances.
